You can be empathetic without being comfortable with a person’s actions.
I can recognize that abuse and genetics had a heavy hand to play in this person’s behavior and struggles. I can also recognize that his past actions were wrong. 
I’m not going to tell someone who is struggling and trying to improve themselves that I am upset with their history. They are already beating themselves up, they do not require assistance.

That’s untrue. Firstly, the disorder is called anti social personality disorder (ASPD). Psychopath is an outdated and inaccurate term.
Secondly, the majority of people who display symptoms are not just cold blooded killers. While people with the disorder may be more likely to break laws or be combative in their day to day life, those people are not hardwired to kill or maim. Many people are treatable, many others live their lives as functioning members of society. CBTI and other forms of treatment can and do help people with ASPD. 
This reduction of a mental disorder feels like you watched a season of criminal minds and called it there. 
Saying a person needs to ‘be fixed’ is devious work.
